description: The bar chart illustrates the popularity of different large language models (LLMs) and their associated answer types across three distinct domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis, labeled "Popularity," ranges from 20 to 220, with a linear scale. The horizontal axis categorizes the data by domain. For each domain, there are six bars representing different LLMs and answer types, as indicated by the legend: Llama3 (blue, diagonal stripes), Qwen2 (red, diagonal stripes), ChatGPT (yellow, diagonal stripes), Acc=0 & GT Ans (black, dots), Acc=0 & Gene Ans (black, squares), and Acc=1 & GT Ans (white, outlined). In the "Movies" category, the popularity values are relatively low, with Llama3 at approximately 25, Qwen2 at 40, and ChatGPT at 30. In the "Songs" category, the values are higher, with Llama3 at about 60, Qwen2 at 70, and ChatGPT at 75. In the "Basketball" category, the popularity is significantly higher, with Llama3 at 100, Qwen2 at 190, and ChatGPT at 175. The bars for Acc=0 & GT Ans, Acc=0 & Gene Ans, and Acc=1 & GT Ans are consistently the shortest across all domains, indicating lower popularity compared to the main LLMs. The chart shows a clear trend of increasing popularity for all models in the "Basketball" domain compared to "Movies" and "Songs."
